summary: Eps 1-25 (S1 + Guilty through the penultimate episode) adapt Nights 1-43 nearly in publication order, with the finale (ep 26, already anchored at ch 46) closing out vol 10 territory. The vampireknight.fandom.com episode infoboxes carry an explicit per-episode 'chapters' field for eps 1-24, cross-checked against Wikipedia episode summaries and chapter titles; volume boundaries match the context file exactly. Structure findings: ch 10 is deferred behind chs 11-12 (eps 7-8), the Guilty opener re-treads the chs 21-22 aftermath before ch 24, chs 23 and 27 are held back and interleaved into eps 16-17, and ch 32 is skipped entirely. Eps 25-26 have no wiki chapter fields because the climax compresses chs 41-46 with rearrangement (senate destruction, ch 43, grafted into the ep 25 battle) and an almost anime-original final scene (ja.wikipedia) that parallels chs 47-49 outcomes; ep 25 anchored 41-43 at medium. No filler anywhere; all 26 episodes canon per animefillerguide.
